# Third-party libraries

- **QtApng**: for loading APNG images, based on `https://github.com/Skycoder42/QtApng`, commit `9c529bd`
- **SortFilterProxyModel**: based on `https://github.com/oKcerG/SortFilterProxyModel`
- **rcheevos** (hash module only): RetroAchievements' game hashing, `https://github.com/RetroAchievements/rcheevos`, commit `bbc79b5`, MIT. Pegasus X uses it to find a game's RetroAchievements entry by its ROM.
